subject: CAIQ proof bundle request — Acme Health
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Hsu <audrey.hsu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ proof bundle request — Acme Health

Hi Audrey and Acme security team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To move the CAIQ review forward on our side, can you confirm the list of controls you need sample artifacts for versus assertions only? To make this painless for both teams, we're preparing a short "proof bundle" with an index and representative artifacts. Suggested contents below — please edit: 

- CAIQ control mapping (CSV) with evidence pointers
- Runtime log extract (redacted) showing call traces and tenant isolation
- Key rotation logs / KMS audit trail (last 90 days)
- Network diagram (VPC peering, NAT, security groups)
- SOC 2 summary and scope page (statement of applicability)
- Third-party attestations (storage/encryption vendors)

We can deliver an initial bundle by EOD Friday, Oct 23, if that timeline works. We will provide a Drive folder and share-by-link; sensitive items we can provision via DocuSign secure transfer if you prefer.

Attached: caiq_scope_manifest.pdf (scope & control list we plan to include).

Ask: can you confirm which CAIQ sections you want full artifacts for, and whether the lists above cover your needs? Also confirm any additional redaction rules for logs (IP truncation, tenant ids).

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: caiq_scope_manifest.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]

From: Audrey Hsu <audrey.hsu@acmehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ proof bundle request — Acme Health

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear plan. That list looks good; a few clarifications from our side: 

- We need full artifacts for: Data Protection (DP), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and Operational Security (OS) controls. For the rest, an assertion with the mapping is fine.
- For logs: redaction for PII is mandatory; IPs can be truncated to /24. Tenant ids should be replaced by stable pseudonyms (e.g., tenant-001).
- KMS audit trail: the last 180 days would be preferable, if feasible.
- Please include any relevant DocuSign links for attested documents (we route those to procurement).

Timeline: EOD Friday is acceptable. We may follow up with a short technical call after we review the bundle.

Best,
Audrey Hsu
Senior Security PM, Acme Health

Subject: Re: CAIQ proof bundle request — Acme Health

Hi Audrey / Naomi — looping in our evidence coordination and control owners. Quick plan:

1) We will assemble a compact proof bundle scoped to the controls Audrey flagged (DP, IAM, OS). The package will include a CSV mapping (control -> artifact filename + locator), short narrative for any compensating controls, and redacted extracts for logs.

2) Owners: Jonas will own runtime logs and KV cache isolation extracts; I will own network diagram, SOC 2 scope, and third-party attestations. Naomi will handle access-control artifacts and the KMS rotation trail.

3) Delivery: initial Drive folder shared by Thursday close of business; we will add a DocuSign envelope for any attested statements (procurement prefers that).

Attachments included in the first push: proof_index.csv (index of artifacts), intake_readme.txt (guidance for reviewers).

If the Acme team wants a short walkthrough after delivery, we can schedule 30 minutes Friday afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proof_index.csv (csv, 14KB)]

Jonas Weber
